title: Implement GitHub Pull Request Tool Using PyGithub
description:
### Changes Made
- Implemented GitHub Pull Request Tool using PyGithub.
- Added functionality to retrieve pull request details from a repository.
- Added support for listing pull requests.
- Implemented JSON export functionality for PR data.
- Implemented Excel export functionality using OpenPyXL.
- Added OOP-based structure with proper classes and methods.
- Added docstrings and type hints following coding standards.

### Validation
- Verified GitHub repository connectivity using Personal Access Token.
- Tested pull request retrieval functionality.
- Verified JSON and Excel report generation.
- Performed code review and formatting updates.

### Benefits
- Automates pull request data collection.
- Generates reports in JSON and Excel formats.
- Demonstrates GitHub API integration using PyGithub.
- Improves maintainability through structured Python code.
